run_policy.protocol: Present each prompt and any supplied conversation context as a Skill-selection task using only installed Skill names and descriptions. Open every selected SKILL.md so loading is observable, report selected names, and do not solve the underlying task.
run_policy.repetition_rule: Run each affected case once per condition, then repeat only when variation, an unexpected result, model differences, or failure impact makes another observation decision-relevant.
run_policy.verdict_rule: Record pass, fail, unstable, not exposed, or not executed for every case. Mixed observed results are unstable, not a pass.
